tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// dpal ye shes kyi lha mo dud sol ma'i gsang sgrub phrin las kyi 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

"$ ༄༅// dpal ye shes kyi lha mo dud sol ma'i gsang ba'i sgrub pa phrin las kyi 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha dbyer med pa la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyal ba dgyes mdzad khyod ni dngos dang dngos bral sngon dang phyi ma'i mtha' rnams spangs pa shes rab pha rol phyin pa'i ye shes mchog ste thub dbang sras bcas skyed pa'i yum// dpe med de las thugs rje'i nyams kyis 'gro ba 'di rnams 'khor ba'i 'jigs las yang dag sgrol dang bstan pa rin chen srung bar byed phyir rmad byung 'jigs med gzugs brnyan gyis// bdud dang bdud kyi phyogs rnams 'joms par mdzad cing ha ha hūm̐ bhyo phaṭ kyi nga ros nam mkha' kun 'gengs lha dang lha min du ma skrag byed mkha' 'gro kun gyi gtso// 'jig rten gsum po skad cig gis bskor sgrub po rnams la phun sum tshogs pa thams cad ster byed yid can kun gyis mchod pa dud sol zhes bya bcom ldan 'das mar 'dud// gang de mchod cing dgyes par byas na phun tshogs dge legs bye ba snyed// rang rang yid bzhin mngon sum nyid du thob par 'gyur ba de phyir 'dir// grub dbang bi ru pakṣa nag po tilli nā ro mar rngog zhabs// gang gsung ji bzhin gsang ba'i sgrub pa nyid las gnang ba thob phyir bri/ 'dir dpal ye shes kyi lha mo dud sol ma'i gsang ba'i sgrub pa la gsum ste/ bsnyen pa dang*/ sgrub pa dang*/ las sbyor ro// dang po bsnyen pa la lnga ste/ dkyil 'khor rten gtor rten rdzas bca' ba/ mtshams bcad srung 'khor lhag pa'i lha bsgom pa/ rten dang brten pa bskyed nas byin rlabs dgug gzhug bya ba/ dam bsgrags mchod gtor 'bul zhing bstod de bzlas pa/ bskang bshags gnyer gtad rjes kyi bya ba'o// dang po dkyil 'khor rten gtor rten rdzas bca' ba ni/ grub pa'i slob dpon nā ro pa'i zhabs kyis/ dam tshig ldan pa'i sgrub pa pos// yid 'ong dben pa'i gnas dag tu// gza' skar dus tshes bzang po la// zhes gsungs pas/

'di nyid kyi rjes su gnang ba thob pa'am dbang bzhi rdzogs par thob pa'i gang zag gis/ bla ma gong ma'i gdan sa'am/ dur khrod la sogs pa'i gnas khyad par can rnams su tshes brgyad dam bco lnga'am/ nyi shu gnyis dang dgu'am gnam gang ste/ mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus bzang po gza' dang skar ma sbyor ba phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa la/ nang gtor phyi gtor btang nas ni// gsol ba gdab cing bden pa bdar// zhes pas sngon 'gro gtor ma gnyis chab kyis bran la/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ bhrūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ khaṃ las gtor ma 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ a kā ro lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs la/ bden pa bdar zhing nag phyogs la dga' ba'i 'byung po rnams la bsngos nas phyi rol du bskrad pa phyi gtor dang*/ nang gtor dkar phyogs dang der gnas kyi gzhi bdag rnams la bsngo zhing mthun rkyen sgrub pa'i phrin las bcol ba'o// de ltar byas nas dkyil 'khor bca' ba ni/ stegs bu gru bzhi mda' gang ba/ dpangs su chag gang ba/ dug dang khrag dur khrod kyi sol bas byugs pa la/ rdul tshon gyis dkyil 'khor mtshan nyid dang ldan pa bris pa'am/ ras bris sam/ 'bru dang me tog nag pos lha mtshan grangs dang mnyam pa dgod par bya'o// de nas rten gtor ni rin po che la sogs pa'i snod gtsang ma'i nang du bshos bu zur gsum khru gang pa ngos gsum du de bas chung ba gsum/ de'i rgyab tu bshos phran bzhi/ de'i rgyab tu brgyad/ de'i rgyab tu bzhi/ de'i rgyab tu mtheb kyus bskor ba bshams nas/ rten rdzas bca' ba/ phyi nang gsang gsum rten rnams bca'// zhes pas/ phyi'i rten sngags pa la dgos pa'i chas gos nag po/ ma ral dang*/ bong bu bya nag lug nag la sogs pa'o// nang rten rma bya nal bu'i rgyal mtshan bhañdza la sogs pa'o// gsang ba'i rten gri snying dang nal bu dgra'i snying la sogs pa'o// mchod rdzas kyang*/

me tog la sogs pa rnam lnga rol mo'i tshogs dang*/ sha sna tshogs/ khrag sna tshogs/ snying sna tshogs/ chang sna tshogs/ bdud rtsi lnga/ tshogs kyi yo byad la sogs mchod pa'i rdzas kyi bye brag ji snyed pa bsham par bya'o// rgyun gtor ram mchod gtor ni/ dpal gtor 'khor gsum gong dang 'dra ba sha khrag la sogs pas brgyan pa'o// gnyis pa mtshams bcad srung 'khor lhag pa'i lha bsgom pa ni/ bde dgyes gdan bzhi la sogs pa he ru ka'i rnal 'byor gang bsgom pa'i rang gzhung gis bya'o// rgya gzhung gnyis su lha mo nyid kyi bdag bskyed bshad pa nang sgrub gtso che ba'i dbang du byas pa'o// gsum pa rten dang brten pa bskyed nas byin rlabs dgug gzhug bya ba ni/ mdun gyi dkyil 'khor dang rten gtor bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las e las chos kyi 'byung gnas yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ yaṃ raṃ waṃ laṃ suṃ las byung ba'i 'byung ba rim brtsegs ri rab dang bcas pa'i steng du hūm̐ las skyes pa'i sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar bhrūm̐ 'od zer kha dog lnga 'phro ba zhu ba las byung ba'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhi dang ldan pa/ phyi bswe'i khang pa ltar dmar lhag ge bar 'dug pa/ nang rin po che sna lnga las grub cing ka ba brgyad gdung bzhi bres pa'i thog phub pa'i dbus 'phyur bu tog dang bcas pa dur khrod brgyad la sogs pas bskor ba'i shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ lte ba mthing kha de'i nang du bcud kyi gzhal yas khang thod mkhar tshar gsum gyi phyi skam po/ bar rnyid pa/ nang rlon pa/ rkang dang sha khrag dag gis spyin byas pa'i mkhar zur gsum pa/ logs gsum la sgo yod pa/ phyi nang thams cad me rlung 'tshub pa/ khrag mtsho khol zhing 'phyo ba'i gnas su gru gsum pa'i rin po che'i sa gzhi'i dbus su/ skad cig tsam gyis ti las rlung gi bong bu dmar gwa la zhing chen gyi stan dang srin po'i thod pa'i ya mgal gyis snga ru ma mgal gyis phyi ru byas pa/

sbrul dang rgyu mas gong smed dang mthur/ zhing chung gis sga g.yogs byas pa'i steng du nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ mthing nag de las 'od 'phros/ gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ ma mo dang mkha' 'gro ma thams cad kyi nus mthu gcig tu bsdus// yongs su gyur pa las dpal ldan lha mo dud pa'i sol ba ma sku mdog nag mo/ nag po'i sprin dang bung ba ltar gnag pa/ shin tu sbeg pa keng rus kyi lus can zhal gcig ga bzhi/ zhabs gnyis/ spyan gsum pa/ g.yas kyi dang po na ral gri me 'bar ba/ 'og ma na bhañdza dmar gyis bskyil ba skra grol ba/ g.yon gyi dang po na shākti'i mtshon cha/ 'og ma na tri shū la'i mgul nas dar dpyangs 'phyar ba/ mi ro rengs pa zhal du bcug cing mche ba bzhi gtsigs pa/ spyan gsum dmar po ldog nas blta ba/ dbu skra ral pa gyen du brdzes shing lan bu g.yon du 'khyil ba/ de la sbrul dang thod phreng gis brgyan pa/ rma bya'i rgyal mtshan gtsug na 'phyar ba/ snyan cha g.yas na sbrul gyi mgul nas dril bu gsil ba/ snyan cha g.yon na seṅge ral dmar can 'phyo ba/ rna ltag gnyis na me tog dang dar nag po'i cod pan 'phur ba/ lha ma yin la sogs pa'i mgo bos do shal du byas pa/ glang po che'i ko rlon gyis stod g.yogs su byas pa/ ba glang gi ko rlon tshal par dras pa la re lde ser po'i sham bu btags pas sku smad dkris pa/ khrag dang zhag gi thig les tshom bur bris pa/ rus pa'i phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ klu chen brgyad kyis ska rags byas pa/ zhabs gnyis lcags sgrog gis brgyan pa/ bong bu gwa dmar gyi steng na tsan 'khyil gyis bzhugs par gyur/ thod mkhar gyi zur gsum du bhyo nag po gsum las/ nag mo gcer bu ral pa can gsum phyag g.yas mi snying rlon pa gtso mo'i zhal du stob cing*/ g.yon bhañdza khrag gis bkang ba 'dzin pa/ thod phreng se ral khar khur ba zhing chen dang re lde/ rus pa'i rgyan la sogs pa dur khrod kyi chas kyis brgyan pa/

rlung gi bong bu gwa dmar la chibs pa/ thod mkhar gyi phyi'i phyogs bzhir bhyo bzhi las rigs bzhi'i lha mo dkar mo dang*/ ser mo/ dmar mo/ ljang nag bzhi'i phyag g.yas par rdo rje rin po che padma rgya gram gyis yu ba byas pa'i gri gug dang g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pa/ dur khrod kyi chas brgyad kyis brgyan cing bong bu la chibs pa/ de'i rgyab kyi shar du bhyo las seṅge'i gdong can/ lhor bhyo las stag gi gdong can/ nub tu bhyo las spyang ki'i gdong can/ byang du bhyo las phag gi gdong can/ byang shar du bhyo las bya rgod kyi gdong can/ shar lhor bhyo las skyung ka'i gdong can/ lho nub tu bhyo las dur bya'i gdong can/ nub byang du bhyo las bya rog gi gdong can/ thams cad kyang nag mo phyag gnyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ dur khrod kyi chas brgyad kyis spras shing drel nag rkang gsum la chibs pa'o// shar sgor bhyo las stag la zhon pa kaṃ ka'i gdong can/ lho sgor bhyo las spyang ki la zhon pa kaṃ ka'i gdong can/ nub sgor bhyo las spre'u la zhon pa kaṃ ka'i gdong can/ byang sgor bhyo las dred nag la zhon pa kaṃ ka'i gdong can/ bzhi ka'ang nag mo phyag bzhi'i dang po gsum gyi g.yas na rim pa bzhin/ mda' gzhu spu gri sbrul gyi zhags pa dang*/ g.yon rnams bhañdza khrag gis bkang ba 'dzin pa/ bzhi pa'i g.yas na rgyu zhags dang g.yon nad kyi rkyal pa bsnams pa/ zhing chen gyi sked dkris re lde ser pos sham bur byas pa/ thod phreng gis brgyan pa/ de'i phyi rol du sprul pa'i las mkhan bye ba 'bum sde/ thugs kyi sprul pa nag mo bye ba 'bum sde/ dkar ser dmar ljang gi sprul pa ma mo bye ba 'bum sde'i tshogs dang*/ gzhan yang sha za nam gru srin mo gnod sbyin mo la sogs pa dmod pa'i mtshon cha can rnams dang*/ ye shes dang las kyi mkha' 'gro la sogs pa thams cad kyang nag mo gcer bu skra bshal ba 'jigs su rung ba'i rgyan dang*/

sna tshogs pa'i mtshon cha thogs par gyur/ gtso 'khor de rnams kyi spyi bor zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par padma la āḥdamar po/ snying kar nyi ma la hūm̐ nag po/ 'khor rnams kyi thugs kar zla ba la bhyos mtshan pa gsal bar gyur pa'i rang dang*/ mdun gyi gtso 'khor rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas/ nag po drag po/ drag po chen po'i dur khrod/ byang puṣpa ha ri/ mar rngog gi gdan sa sogs nas dpal ldan lha mo dud pa'i sol ba ma 'khor nag mo 'bum sde'i tshogs kyis bskor ba badzra sa ma dzaḥ hūm̐ bhyoḥ ri rab chen po'i byang shar mtshams// g.yu mtsho mu le'i deng gi dbus// rin chen lnga ldan gzhal yas khang*// de dbus srid gsum thod mkhar nang*// gru gsum 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas// dpal ldan lha mo dud sol ma// sku mdog nag mo 'jigs pa'i gzugs// zhal gcig phyag bzhi bong bu chibs// 'khor yang ma mo 'bum sdes bskor// gnas 'di nyid du gshegs su gsol// da lta snyigs ma'i dus 'di ru// dam can bzhugs par mi 'os kyang*// sngon tshe byang chub shing drung du// thub pa chen po'i spyan snga ru// ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas ltar// sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba dang*// 'gro kun bde la 'god pa'i phyir// dpal ldan lha mo gshegs su gsol// gsang sngags srung ma dam tshig can// 'khor bcas gshegs shing bzhugs su gsol// zhes pa dang*/ bhyoḥ rang bzhin rnam dag ye shes sgyu ma'i klong*// bde chen 'du 'bral med pa'i dkyil 'khor nas// dus gsum rgyal ba'i phrin las gcig bsdus pa// dpal 'bar mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo dbyings nas bzhengs// dur khrod rgyu zhing rnal 'byor las la 'breng*// mi bzad rnam par sprul pa'i zhing rnams dang*// puṣpa ha ri mar rngog gdan sa sogs// mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i gnas nas 'dir gshegs shig/ ces spyan drangs nas dgug pa dang gzhug pa dang bcing ba dang dbang du bya ba'i sngags 'di bya'o//

dṛṣya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs ma ya hoḥ zhes brjod pas ye shes pa dang dam tshig pa dbyer med du gyur/ bzhi pa dam bsgrags mchod gtor 'bul zhing bstod de bzlas pa ni/ de nas gzugs dngos su ston par bsgom/ de ltar mi ston na/ oṃ hūm̐ bhyo ā ra li hriṃ dzaḥ zhes brjod cing gzir/ dud pa'i sol ba ma khyod kyis bdag gi sems la ci 'dod pa'i don thams cad 'grub par gyis shig ces mngon sum du byung na brjod par bya'o// de yang las la sbyar ba'i tshe/ rigs kyi dam tshig sbyin te/ dam tshig kyang gur gum gyi chu la sngags 'di btab la sbyin no// zhes rgya gzhung du 'byung yang*/ rdo rje 'chang chen po rje btsun mar rngog gi phyag bzhes la nang mchod gtor nas/ oṃ badzra ha na ha na badzra sa ma ya ma ti kra ma hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces dam tshig gi chu sbyin nas bsgo bar bya'o// lha mo khyod dam tshig 'di las 'das nas bsgo ba bzhin du ma byas na gzir ba chen po byed pa dang*/ dam tshig gi chu 'di'ang dug ha la ha la chen por 'gyur te/ 'thung pas khrag tu skyug pa dang*/ rdo rje za byed chen pos snying dral te dus ma yin par 'chi bar 'gyur ba dang*/ gnod sbyin gyis gsod par 'gyur ba dang*/ snying 'gas pa dang*/ khro bo za byed chen po dang 'jigs byed chen por 'gyur te/ me dbal rdo rje 'bar bas tshig nas lus thal bar 'gyur te so so rang rang gis mna' bor ba bzhin du dmyal ba dang 'bod sgrog tu skye bar 'gyur ro// zhes dam tshig bor ro/ /de nas mchod rdzas rnams bsangs sbyangs mi dmigs pa las/ thod pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du ngo bo zag med kyi bdud rtsi/ rnam pa mchod rdzas bzang zhing rgya che ba rgyal sras kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po chen po lta bus nam mkha'i dbyings khyab par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥswā hā/ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs shing 'bul ba ni/

hūm̐ bhyoḥ lha min rnams dang dgra bgegs bsgral ba yi// snying khrag dang 'dres dug chu khol ma'i rgyun// rgya mtshor bskyil ba'i mi zad arghaṃ 'di// mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// shrī mān de wi dhū maṃ gā ri sa pa ri wā re bhyaḥ.arghaṃ pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐ phaṭ/ dri med yid 'ong lha rdzas bzang po dang*// drag po'i chu dang rdo rje dri chur bcas// gdug pa'i dri ldan zhabs bkru 'di dag kyang*// mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug= sngags thog ma dang tha ma 'dra ba las arghaṃ gyi gnas su badzra pā dyaṃ dang*/ nyams pa bsgral ba'i dbang po rnam lnga ni// ri ltar spungs shing utpal cher 'dzings dug /mthun pa'i me tog phreng ba ltar spel ba// mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug= puṣpe= sna tshogs spos mchog bsregs dang gsur chen gyi// dud sprin mkha' la 'khrigs pa'i dri zhim ngad// phyogs bcu'i mthar 'gro rdo rje bdug spos kyang*// mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug= dhu pe= tsandan ga pur zil dngar snying po dang*// sha khrag rus pa dgra bo'i mkhris zhag dug /byug par sbyar ba'i mi bzad dri ldang chab// mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug= gandhe= bgrang yas ro dang bcud ldan zhal zas mchog /bzang zhing 'tshal ba ma tshangs med pa rnams// srid pa'i 'dod dgu'i gtos dang mnyam spel ba// mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug= nai wi dya= lha mi'i sil snyan rnga dang mi rkang dung*// dkrol 'bud brdung dang glu dbyangs rgya mtsho'i sgras// zhing rnams shig shig g.yo byed 'di dag kyang*// mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug= shapta= 'bru tshil g.yul du bsad pa'i zhun chen ni// ro ras kyis sbags snang byed sbar ba'i mes// ma lus mchog tu gsal ba'i sgron me 'di// mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug= ā lo ke= lha mi'i longs spyod mchog tu gyur pa yi// nyer spyad 'os pa mdzes shing cher mdzes sdug /zhing rdul grangs mtshungs mkho dgu ji snyed pa// mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// rū pa=

bsam yas snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs gang dag gis// phyogs bcu'i nam mkha'i khams kun rnam 'gengs pa// lha rdzas bzang po'i rol mo 'di dag kyang*// mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug= shapta= legs par sbyar ba'i dri mchog dam pa yis// srid pa'i gdung ba ma lus zhi byed pa// rab 'byams dri zhim char bzhin 'bab pa'i chab// mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug= gandhe= ro dang bdud rtsi'i bcud ldan bza' ba dang*// btung dang bldag gzhib 'dzin ma'i khyon 'di nyid// kun bzang mchod pa'i phung po ltar bkang ba// mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug= rā sya= mtha' klas nam mkha'i gtos dang mnyam gyur pa'i// dbang po'i tshon ltar rnam bkra'i na bza' ni// reg pa'i bde bas dbang po tshim byed pa// mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug 'khor= sparshe= dgra bo'i sha chen sha sna ri ltar spungs// nyams pa'i snying chen snying snas srid gsum gtams// gdug pa'i dmar chen dmar sna mtsho ltar bskyil// zhing bcu'i klad chen klad snas stong gsum bkang*// rgyud chen phreng ba dkrigs pa nam mkha'i mthar// 'dod dgu'i yon tan rnams ni sprin ltar gtibs// ba ling gtor ma'i tshogs ni skar ltar bkram// mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug= oṃ ma hā māṃ sa khā hi/ ma hā tsitta khā hi/ ma hā rakta khā hi/ ma hā go ro tsa na khā hi/ ma hā ba su ta khā hi/ oṃ i daṃ ba lingta gṛhṇa gṛhṇa sa ma ya hūm̐ phaṭ swā hā/ nam mkha' ltar yangs thod pa rdo rje'i snod// sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga sbyar rdo rje'i rdzas// mchog gi rgyal ba rdo rjes byin brlabs pa// mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ shrī mān de wi dhū maṃ gā ri sa pa ri wā re bhyaḥsarba pañtsa a mṛ ta pū dza khā hi/

de nas gtor ma bdud rtsis bran la/ gtor snod bhañdza yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor rdzas rnams ha ho hrīḥ ha ser pos gtor ma'i kha dog ngan pa bcom nas kha dog phun sum tshogs pa gser zhun ma lta bur gyur/ hoḥdakar pos gtor ma'i dri ngan pa bcom nas dri phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur/ hrīḥsngon pos gtor ma'i ro ngan pa bcom nas ro phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥswā hā/ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs la/ shrī mān de wi dhū maṃ gā ri sa pa ri wā re bhyaḥ i daṃ ba ling gṛhṇa gṛhṇa sa ma ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ gsung rgyun ltar na sa pa ri wā ra i da ba lingta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ snying po/ oṃ hūm̐ shrī ya de wi ka li ka li ma hā ka li hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐/ gsung rgyun du sa pa ri wā ra sogs so sor lan gsum mam lnga dang bdun nyer gcig la sogs pas phul bas/ dpal ldan lha mo 'khor bcas rnams kyis hab dir gyis gsol bar bsams la phrin las bcol ba ni/ mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug dud pa'i sol ba ma 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma kha dog dam pa/ dri dam pa/ ro dam pa/ reg bya dam pa 'di bzhes la/ rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa'i nad kyi rigs su gyur pa rlung mkhris bad kan 'dus pa las gyur pa'i nad thams cad zhi zhing bzlog par mdzad du gsol/ gdon gyi rigs su gyur pa lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin dang*/ rgyal po'i gdon pa la sogs pa thams cad zhi zhing bzlog par mdzad du gsol/ rmi lam ngan pa dang mtshan ma ngan pa la sogs pa spang bya mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad bzlog cing zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ gzhan yang rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyi grogs gyis/ mthun gyis/ dpung gyis/ sngun nas bsus/ phyi nas skyor/ bsam pa sgrubs/

re ba skongs/ ji ltar 'dod pa'i don thams cad mthar phyin pa'i phrin las mdzod cig ces gsol bas de ltar bgyi'o zhes khas blangs par bsam mo// de ltar mchod pa rdzogs par phul nas bstod de/ rgyud las/ de ltar bstod pa byed pa'i rnal 'byor pas// chos kyi srog shing chos kyi rgyal mtshan bsgrengs// chos kyi dung 'bud chos kyi sgron me sbar// dge la mos shing dad pas lha mo la// bos shing bstod pa mchog ni dus drug gam// yang na mtshan mo re la rtag par ni// gang gis bstod pa rnga gling dbyangs dang bcas// bstod pa tsam gyis lha mos rtag tu srung*// mnyes nas bstod pa po yi grib bzhin 'breng*// bsam pa'i dgos pa thams cad yongs su 'grub// ces gsungs pas/ rnga dang sil snyan la sogs pa'i rol mo dang dbyangs snyan pos bstod par bya ba yin la/ de la thog mar sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi sgo nas bstod pa ni/ bhyoḥ dpal ldan lha mo mi pham srid gsum bdag /rang don sgrub phyir rnam thar gsum gzhol yang*// snying rje'i dbang gis rjes la thob pa yi// shes rab sna tshogs thabs kyis 'gro don mdzad// lha mo nag mo sku mdog char sprin mdog /mtshan mo nag mo shin tu gtum pa'i gzugs// shin tu sbeg cing keng rus gzugs 'chang ma// zhal gcig phyag bzhi zhabs gnyis brjid pa'i sku// ral pa gyen brdzes lan bu g.yon du 'khyil// skra ser sbrul dang thod pa'i phreng bas brgyan// rna ltag me tog dar nag cod pan can// khrag dang chang gis ra ro spyan rtsa dmar// mi ro rengs pa khar bcug mche ba bzhi// rnam par gtsigs nas khrag la shin tu dgyes// snyan g.yas sbrul gyi mgul nas dril bu gsil// gdug pa btul nas tshangs pa'i sgra sgrog ma// snyan cha g.yon na seṅge'i ral dmar 'phyo// dpa' mo khams gsum seṅge'i sgra sgrog ma// bhyoḥ phyag bzhi'i g.yas kyi dang po ral gri 'phyar// 'og ma bhañdza rakta dmar bskyil 'dzin// g.yon gyi dang po shākti'i mtshon cha bsnams// 'og ma tri shū'i mgul nas dar dpyang 'phyar// shākti ral gri mtshon gyis bcad pa yi// lha ma yin sogs mgo bos do shal byas// glang po che yi ko rlon stod g.yogs can// smad ni ba glang ko rlon dras pa la// phyi nas re lde ser po'i sham bur dkris// klu yi dbang po gshibs pa'i sked bcings can// zhabs gnyis lcags sgrog dag gis mdzes par brgyan// khrag zhag mang pos thig le tshom bur bris// bhyoḥ

bong bu gwa zhon mtshan mo dur khrod rgyu// bong bu'i rmig pa rlung gi shugs 'chang ma// khams gsum skad cig tsam la bskor bar byed// skad ni dung dang 'brug gi sgra lta bus// ma mo mkha' 'gro sha za dbang du sdud// lho phyogs gshin rje'i pho brang rtag tu gnas// dam pa'i ngang nas gzugs sku gnyis gzigs ma// ting 'dzin dbang thob gzugs khams gnas su byon// tshangs pa'i rgyal po la sogs phyag byas ma// gzhan la dbang sgyur 'dod khams mthar yang phyin// dbang phyug chen po'i sku la dgyes 'khril ma// sum cu rtsa gsum tshal du byon pa'i tshe// lha rnams dbugs phyung brgya byin phyag byas ma// lha ma yin rnams phung bar byas pa'i tshe// lha min dbang po kun gyis phyag byas ma// sku mchog ri rab che dang 'gran pa'i tshe// lte ba'i thad kyi phyogs nas nyi zla shar// rgyal chen bzhi la sogs pas phyag byas ma// rgya mtsho'i gting nas me 'bar mtsho skems nus// sa 'og klu dbang kun gyis phyag byas ma// lha mo khyod kyis cho 'phrul 'di bstan pas// bdud dang gshin rje'i rgyal po 'dar zhing 'dud// ma mo srin mo'i tshogs rnams 'dar zhing dngangs// bhyoḥ tsitta rin chen gur phub gzhal yas nas// nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor brtsegs pa'i 'od zer 'bar// phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten dug gi bcud bsdus nas// nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dag la thim par mdzad// dug gi rlangs pas nag po'i phyogs rnams kyi// bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rnams lhong mdzad ma// de phyir nad kyi bdag mo dam la 'dud// phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten bdud rtsi'i bcud bsdus nas// zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dag la thim par mdzad// bdud rtsi'i rlangs pas dkar po'i phyogs rnams kyi// bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rnams rtsad gcod ma// bdud rtsi sman gyi rgyal mo dam la 'dud// gang zhig khyod la dad na ma bas byams// de phyir ma gcig nad bdag sman gyi gtso// lha mo khyod la bdag gis rtag tu bstod// rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod//

ces drang srong seṅge'i nga ros bstod pa dngos grub 'byung ba'i rgyud las gsungs so// lha mo'i rtags kyi bstod pa ni/ ma bhyoḥ bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na// rlug nag 'tshub chen rab tu 'khyil ba'i dbus// 'phrul gyi gzhal yas thod pa'i sku mkhar na// 'dod khams dbang phyug lha mo dud sol ma// nag mo chen mo rngam pa'i mche ba can// gcer bu ral pa'i gseb nas me stag 'phro// lha mo sku mdog nag mor bzhugs pa ni// don dam dbyings las bskyod pa med pa'i rtags// dbu skra kham ser sbrul gyis bcings pa ni// zhe sdang gdug pa'i bgegs dpung 'joms pa'i rtags// ral pa g.yas nas g.yon du 'khyil ba ni// yum gyi mkha' la sprul pa 'gyed pa'i rtags// ral pa spyi gtsug gcig tu 'khyil ba ni// skye med don dam gcig tu dgongs pa'i rtags// rma bya'i rgyal mtshan gtsug tu 'phyar ba ni// nyon mongs dug gsum rtsad nas gcod pa'i rtags// thod skam lnga yis dbu la brgyan pa ni// bde gshegs rigs lnga rnam par dag pa'i rtags// snyan g.yas sbrul nag gdeng ka 'phyo ba ni// zhe sdang ma spangs gnas su dag pa'i rtags// snyan g.yon seṅge ral dmar 'phyo ba ni// gsung gi nga ros khams gsum g.yo ba'i rtags// snyan cha gser gyi dril bu 'khrol ba ni// sangs rgyas kun gyi bstan gnyer mdzad pa'i rtags// rna ltag me tog dar nag g.yo ba ni// lha rnams g.yul las rgyal bar mdzad pa'i rtags// spyan rtsa dmar la spyan gsum bsgrad pa ni// sgrub pa po la bu bzhin gzigs pa'i rtags// shangs nas khrag dang zhag gi dri snom pa// gnod byed gdug pa can rnams myul ba'i rtags// zhal du mi ro rengs pa bcug pa ni// dam nyams dgra bo zhal du gsol ba'i rtags// rno gdug mche ba zur gsum gtsigs pa ni// dgra bgegs sha la chem chem rol pa'i rtags// phyag g.yas gcod pa'i ral gri 'phyar ba ni// dam nyams dgra bo'i srog rtsa gcod pa'i rtags// 'og ma thod rlon dmar bskyil 'dzin pa ni// srid gsum sha khrag zhal du gsol ba'i rtags// phyag g.yon shakti'i mtshon cha 'dzin pa ni// lha ma yin gyi dmag dpung sgrol ba'i rtags// 'og ma tri shū dar dpyangs 'phyar ba ni// bdud dpung rnams kyi rgyal mtshan snyol ba'i rtags// rus pa'i rgyan cha lnga yis mdzes pa ni// thugs rje sprul skus 'gro don mdzad pa'i rtags// thal chen tshom bus sku la byugs pa ni// stong nyid chos sku'i don dang ldan pa'i rtags// khrag zhag thig les sku la brgyan pa ni// thugs rje'i don dam bcud la mnga' ba'i rtags// glang po che yi ko rlon gsol ba ni// theg pa mchog gi don dang ldan pa'i rtags// re lde ser po'i sham bu btags pa ni// 'jig rten 'di na che btsan ldan pa'i rtags// klu chen brgyad kyis ska rags byas pa ni// klu rigs thams cad dbang du sdud pa'i rtags// thod rlon lnga bcus do shal byas pa ni// lha min tshogs rnams skrag par byed pa'i rtags// lte ba'i thad nas nyi zla 'char ba ni// nyon mongs ma rig mun pa sel ba'i rtags// rin chen lcags sgrog zhabs la 'khril ba ni// 'dod khams 'dul ba'i dbang dang ldan pa'i rtags// bong bu gwa pa chibs su chibs pa ni// gti mug don dam chos nyid bsre ba'i rtags// dpyi steng mig gis phyogs bcur blta ba ni// gnod byed gang na 'dug kyang 'gugs pa'i rtags// zhing chung lpags pas sga g.yogs byas pa ni// sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung bar mdzad pa'i rtags// srin po'i thod pas sga ru byas pa ni// bdud dang srin po zil gyis gnon pa'i rtags// sbrul nag stong gis gong smed byas pa ni// nyams pa can la mdze nad gtong ba'i rtags// srin po'i thod pa gong la btags pa ni// ma mo srin mo las la 'gyed pa'i rtags// nad kyi rkyal pa smad la bcings pa ni// dgra bo'i yul du nad rims 'gyed pa'i rtags// me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa ni// ye shes chen pos rnam rtog bsreg pa'i rtags// rlung nag 'tshub ma phyogs bcur 'khyil ba ni// lha srin sde brgyad dam la 'du ba'i rtags// nag mo 'bum phrag bran du 'khol ba ni// dgra bgegs gang yin chams la 'bebs pa'i rtags// bhyoḥ

'jigs gzugs khrag 'thung lha mo dud sol ma// nag mo 'bum sde'i tshogs dang bcas pa la// māṃ sa rakta tsittas brgyan pa yi// dmar gyi gtor mas khyod kyi thugs dam bskang*// ba ling mchod par bzhes shig dam tshig can// gsol zhig bzhes shig chos skyong srung ma'i gtso// 'khor gyi tshogs rnams pho nyar da thongs la// bstan pa 'jig pa'i dgra bgegs rdul du rlog /ma gcig rgyab nas me 'bar rgya mtsho skem// phyag nas 'jigs pa'i mtshon chas ri rab bsnyil// dbu skra ral pa 'thibs pas stong gsum 'gengs// zhal du mi sha rlon pa rtag tu gsol// ljags la khrag dang zhag gi rgya mtsho 'khyil// gsung ni 'brug gi sgra ltar phyogs bcur sgrog /bdag gis khyod la bstod pa 'bul lags na// bstan pa bsrung ba'i las 'di myur du sgrubs// zhes bram ze chen po mchog sred kyis mdzad pa'o// gzhan yang*/ bhyoḥ sngon tshe dpag bsam byang chub shing gi drung*// rgyal ba thub pa chen po'i spyan snga ru// bstan pa gnyan po bsrung bar dam bcas pa'i// khrag 'thung dud sol sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// khyod kyi yon tan stobs dang gzi brjid las// ma mo mkha' 'gro bye bas bskor ba'i dbus// gtum zhing 'gying bag rngams pa'i tshul du bzhugs// srid gsum zil gyis gnon la phyag 'tshal bstod// don dam mi g.yo sku mdog shin tu gnag /klu rnams 'dul phyir dbu skra sbrul gyis bcings// rigs lnga rnam dag thod skam lnga yis brgyan// thugs rjes 'gro don mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod// yang dag don rtogs thal chen tshom bus brgyan// dug gsum spong phyir rma bya'i rgyal mtshan btsugs// dgra bgegs sgrol phyir khrag zhag thig ler bris// rdzu 'phrul mthu stobs ldan la phyag 'tshal bstod// zhe sdang dag phyir snyan g.yas sbrul nag 'phyo// khams gsum sgra sgrog snyan g.yon seṅges brgyan// snyan pa sgrog phyir gser gyi dril bu 'chang*// khams gsum skad cig khyab la phyag 'tshal bstod// dgra bgegs sgrol phyir spyan gsum phyogs bcur gzigs// sha chen gsol phyir mi ro zhal du bcug

/bdud bzhi 'joms phyir rno gdug mche ba gtsigs// ma rungs rdul du rlog la phyag 'tshal bstod// chos nyid don ldan zhing chen lpags pa gsol// theg mchog gsum ldan glang chen ko rlon brgyan// stong gsum grags ldan re lde'i sham bus dkris// smon lam rnam dag khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// dgra srog gcod phyir phyag g.yas ral gri 'phyar// bdud khrag gsol phyir 'og ma thod rlon 'dzin// srid gsum sgrol phyir g.yon pa shākti bsnams// g.yul ngo bzlog phyir 'og ma tri shūl 'dzin// chos nyid don rtogs rus pa'i rgyan gyis spras// lha min 'dul phyir thod rlon do shal byas// rdzu 'phrul ston phyir lcags sgrog 'bar bas brgyan// bdud dpung skrag par mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod// srin po 'dul phyir sprul pa'i bong bu chibs// stong gsum khyab phyir 'tshub ma'i nang du bzhugs// dur khrod gnas phyir sha za mang pos bskor// snang srid dbang sdud gsung ni 'brug ltar sgrog /rnam rtog sreg mdzad me dpung dbus na bzhugs// stobs chen dam tshig can la phyag 'tshal bstod// bhyoḥ khyod kyi g.yas nas sprul pa'i las mkhan ni// dmar mo spyan gsum lcags kyi ral pa can// phyag g.yas lcags kyus dgra bgegs snying nas 'gugs// dam nyams 'ching byed zhags pa g.yon na thogs// stong khams rgyu phyir chibs su bong bu chibs// drag mo 'gugs byed gsum la phyag 'tshal bstod// khyod kyi g.yon nas sprul pa'i las mkhan ni// nag mo spyan gsum khrag gi ral pa can// ma rungs gsod byed phyag g.yas ral gri 'phyar// gtso la stob phyir tsitta g.yon na thogs// dur khrod chas brgyan chibs su bong bu chibs// dgra bgegs gsod byed gsum la= khyod kyi mdun nas sprul pa'i las mkhan ni// gcer bu spyan gsum dung gi mche ba can// gnod byed sun 'byin phyag g.yas dgra snying thogs// gdug pa skrag mdzad g.yon na thod khrag 'dzin// mkha' la rgyu phyir rlung gi bong bu chibs// dmar mo tsa muṇḍi la phyag=

khyod kyi rgyab nas las byed pho nya ni// dmar nag phur pa'i lha mo re ma ti// spyan gsum mche gtsigs gtum sbeg dre 'u zhon// phyag g.yas ral gris dam nyams srog rtsa gcod// g.yon pa lcags kyus dgra bo'i snying nas 'dren// nag mo thun khrag 'bebs la phyag= khyod kyi thugs las sprul pa'i mkha' 'gro ni// sku mdog dkar ser dmar ljang bong bu chibs// phyag gnyis gri gug bhañdza khrag bkang bsnams// phrin las sgrub mdzad bzhi la phyag= khrag 'thung nag mo'i spyan sngar khas blangs pa'i// shar nas sprul pa'i las mkhan pho nya ni// dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis seṅge'i gdong*// dur khrod chas brgyan gri dang thod pa 'dzin// drel nag rkang gsum chibs nas phyogs bcur rgyug /'gying zhing dgra bgegs rol la phyag 'tshal bstod// lho nas dmar nag zhal gcig stag gi gdong*// dur khrod chas brgyan gri dang thod pa 'dzin// drel nag rkang gsum chibs nas gnod byed kyi// khro zhing sha la rol la= nub nas sngo nag zhal gcig spyang ki'i gdong*// dur khrod chas brgyan= drel nag rkang gsum chibs nas bgegs rnams 'joms// rgyug cing dgra sha rol la= byang nas mthing nag zhal gcig phag gi gdong*// dur khrod chas brgyan= drel nag rkang gsum chibs nas 'byung po'i sha /'dur zhing zhal du stob la phyag= byang shar mtshams nas smug nag bya rgod gdong*// dur khrod chas brgyan= drel nag zhon nas dgra bgegs sha khrag rnams// rngam zhing rngam zhing rol la= shar lho mtshams nas mun mdog skyung ka'i gdong*// dur khrod chas brgyan= drel nag zhon nas dgra bgegs ma lus pa// mchong zhing mchong zhing gsol la= lho nub mtshams nas khrag mdog dur bya'i gdong*// dur khrod chas brgyan= drel nag zhon nas nyams pa srog dang 'bral// rgod cing rgod cig 'joms la= nub byang mtshams nas dud mdog bya rog gdong*// dur khrod chas brgyan=

drel nag zhon nas dgra bgegs snying nas 'dren// lding zhing lding zhing rol la= las mkhan pho nya nag mo kaṅka'i gdong*// kun kyang mda' gzhu spu gri bhañdza dang*// sbrul zhags bhañdza rgyu zhags nad rkyal bsnams// ma rungs 'ching byed rnams la= zhing chen stod g.yogs re lde'i sham bus dkris// thod rlon do shal chibs su stag spyang dang*// spre'u dred nag zhon nas pho nya 'gyed// dgra bgegs sgrol byed bzhi la= gzhan yang las mkhan bye ba 'bum sde dang*// ma mo mkha' 'gro bdud mo bye ba'i tshogs// nag mo gcer bu 'jigs shing skra bshal ba// zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri dang thod pa 'dzin// stong khams ma lus sprin gyi tshogs ltar 'thibs// srid gsum g.yo bar mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod// de ltar bstod cing khyod la zhu ba ni// sngon gyi thugs dam gnyan po brtser dgongs la// bdag cag rnal 'byor dam tshig ldan pa dang*// bstan la rab dad dkar po'i phyogs rnams la// bdud rtsi'i rgyun phob nad rnams zhi ba dang*// longs spyod tshe dang 'bru sogs 'phel bar mdzod// ma rungs sems 'dzin nag po'i phyogs rnams la// dug gi rlung bus nad kyis gzir zhing slong*// khong khrag skyug cing cho nges gnam du 'debs// smyo 'bog thongs la bdun rgyud rtsad nas chod// bdud dang dgra bgegs 'byung po rdul du rlog /bstan pa srung mdzad las 'di myur du sgrubs//

zhes rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug rdo rje bi ru pa dpal ldan chos skyong zhabs kyis zhal gzigs dus su mdzad pa'o// gzungs las phyung ba'i bstod pa ni/ bhyoḥ til mar gyis bskus lan bu gcig 'phyang ro nye'i rna chas sgeg cing cha lugs ma lus 'chang*// rgyan du rkang sgrog lcags las byas pa gcig gis rang gi rkang pa mdzes par byas pa ste// gcer bu bong bu zhon nas 'gro ba 'di na rgyu ba 'di ni lha mo khyod nyid kyis// bdag nyid mdzes par shes kyis gzhan ltas khyod kyi spyod pa mtsho chen don dag su yis shes// 'khor ba 'jig pa'i tshe na mi lus dag la khrag dang zhag 'dzag dud pa 'thul ba na// lha mo mche ba gtsigs pa khyod kyi zhal du 'gro kun skad cig tsam gyis zhugs par gyur// nag mo mi thod thogs pa khyod ni rnal 'byor grub pa'i spyod yul can de dur khrod dgyes// khyod ni g.yon can mnan cing nad dang 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa sel zhing mi zad dril yang sgrog /khyod ni dpa' bo dag gi mgo bo'i cod pan legs spras g.yul du mtshon gyis bcad pa yi// phreng ba thogs shing gar byed lag pa mnyen brkyang rkub tshos che la klu dbang gshibs pa yi// ska rags 'chang zhing lag tu mdung dang ral gri thogs pa khrag dang chang gis myos gyur pas// mig rtsa dmar por gyur cing mtshan mo dur khrod rgyu ba 'byung po phal cher rnams kyis mthong*// ko rlon chen po dral te brgyangs pa'i gos kyis stod g.yogs smad ni re lde ser pos dkris// mi yi rgyu ma gsar pa'i sbubs kyis zhal gyi zla ba brgyan cing dril bu 'gram par 'khrol// lus ni snum gyis gsar du byugs shing khrag dang zhag mang 'dzag pa'i thig les tshom bur bris// mi yi sha la so yis chem chem gcod byed thod pa can gyis bdag la skyong gyur cig /drag po drag mo mi bzad mi sha kha na thogs pa sngon chad ma byung khyod mthong na// ma mo rnams kyang skrag cing rtab la rngam pa 'don cing mig rtsa rig rig khyod la 'dud// nag mo bzang mo lus mdog gnag cing bzod par dka' ba khyod la brgya byin la sogs kyang*// zhabs la nyin re bzhin du bstod par byed cing gshin rje'i rgyal po nyid kyang rtag tu 'dar zhing 'dud// mi rnams dang ni 'gro ba ma lus mjug brtul nas ni khyod kyi rna ba ya gcig la// brang gis 'gro ba'i gdengs ka stong dang ldan pa gcig gis rgyab nas khyod la rgyan du byas// ya gcig la ni seṅge mtshungs med thogs shing rgya mtsho'i mtha' bskor sa gzhi ma lus gnon// steng nas rgyu ba'i nyi ma 'od zer stong ldan de ni khyod kyi lte ba'i phyogs su shar// bhyoḥ

rgya mtsho'i klong nas me 'bar khyod// mtsho rnams skem par nus ma ste// bud med thams cad zhi mdzad phyir// lha chen sku yi phyed du bzhugs// rdzong dang dka' bzlog nag mo che// lha dang lha min phyag byas ma// mi nad gang yin khyod ming shes// de la 'jigs pa med par 'gyur// gshin rje'i lcam mo bdud kyi yum// 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma// nad do cog gi bdag mo ste// sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba yi// dpal ldan lha mo khyod la 'dud// dpal ldan gsang chen me 'bar dud sol ma// mi pham khams gsum zil gnon 'dod dbang ma// phyi nang gsang ba'i gdon bgegs rims la sogs// dran pa tsam gyis skyob cing rab zhi ba'i// g.yar dam gnyan po deng 'dir brtser dgongs shig/ don gyi sgo nas bstod pa ni/ bhyoḥ g.yu mtsho mer ba'i 'gram shed na// rlung 'tshub dmar nag 'khyil ba'i dbus// srin po'i bong bu gwa dmar la// zhing chen rgyu ma'i mthur du byas// srin po'i ya mgal snga ru la// ma mgal dag gis phyi ru byas// zhing chen sga stan zhing chung gi /sga g.yogs sbrul nag gong smed byas// ru tra phru gu'i sga g.yogs can// de steng lha mo dud sol ma// sku mdog nag mo 'jigs pa'i gzugs// zhal gcig phyag bzhi spyan gsum khros// zhabs gnyis tsan 'khyil brkyang bskum bzhugs// ral pa'i thor tshugs g.yon du 'khyil// las su khams gsum dbang du sdud// snyan g.yas sbrul nag gdengs ka 'phyo// thod skam lnga yis dbu la brgyan// gtsug na rma bya'i rgyal mtshan btsugs// thal chen tshom bu sku la byugs// khrag zhag thig les zo ris btab// snyan g.yon seṅge ral dmar 'phyo// snyan gnyis gser gyi dril bu 'khrol// rna ltag me tog chun pos brgyan// sku stod glang chen zhing lpags gsol// sku smad re lde ser po dang*// stag gzig lpags pa'i sham thabs gsol// rin chen rus rgyan sbrul gyis spras// mche ba zur gsum cung zad gtsigs// khro gnyer thod phreng se ral 'chang*// phyag g.yas ral gri me 'od 'phyar// 'og ma thod rlon khrag bkang gsol// phyag g.yon shākti rma bya can// 'og ma tri shūl rtse gsum thogs// dpral ba'i dkyil nas zla gsal zhing*// lte ba'i dbus nas nyi ma 'char// dbang gi lcags sgrog zhabs la 'khril// bong bu'i steng nas phyogs bcur gzigs// me dpung nang na 'gying bag bzhugs// shin tu sbeg pa'i cha byad can// srid pa'i ma mo khri phrag dang*// las kyi ma mo khri phrag ni// drug cu rtsa bzhis rab tu bskor// dpal ldan lha mo khyod la bstod//

ces srin po'i rgyal po laṅka mgrin bcus bstod pa'o// rgyan bstod ni/ bhyoḥ byang shar thod pa 'phrul gyi gzhal yas nas// lha mo nag mo mthu dang rdzu 'phrul can// dbang phyug srid pa gsum gyi bdag mo ste// khyod ni khams gsum kun gyis mchod cing bskur// tshangs pa'i rgyal pos rma bya'i rgyal mtshan phul// khyab 'jug chen pos nyi zla rgyan du phul// rnam thos sras kyis seṅge'i rna rgyan phul// nam mkha'i lha bran gser gyi dril bu phul// klu yi rgyal pos sbrul gyi gdengs ka phul// lha dbang brgya byin glang chen ko rlon phul// lha ma yin gyis dar nag cod pan phul// ma mo rnams kyis re lde'i sham bu phul// sha za rnams kyis khrag zhag thig le phul// mkha' 'gro rnams kyis rus pa'i rgyan cha phul// gshin rje'i rgyal pos thod pa'i rgyan phreng phul// srin po'i rgyal pos lcags sgrog sngon po phul// 'khor los sgyur rgyal lha mi'i rgyal srid phul// de ltar rgyan gyi rnam pa du ma yis// dpal ldan lha mo khyod la bstod 'bul na// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa yi// tshe dang bsod nams la sogs rgyas pa dang*// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub ma lus stsol// bdag la rtag tu sdang ba'i sems ldan pa'i// dam nyams dgra bo'i srog rtsa myur du chod// ces pa de ltar bstod pa rnams kyi rjes su/ oṃ ru ru ro ru bi dhiṣṭha ba dhwa si ka ma la rakṣa si hūm̐ bhyo/ che ge mo mā ra ya phaṭ/ ces pa bzla zhing dmar brlab gtor ma bsgreng*/ brgya rtsa brgyad dam yang na nyi shu rtsa gcig bzla zhes rgya gzhung du 'byung*/ bzlas pa bya ba ni/ lha mo thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐/ de'i mtha' mar oṃ hūm̐ shrī ya de wī kā li kā li ma hā kā li hūm̐ bhyo/ zhes pa'i sngags kyi phreng ba nag pos bskor bar bsam/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer spros lha mo'i thugs kar phog

/thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul te sngon dam bcas pa dran pas lha mo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ 'khor dang dregs pa can thams cad kyi snying kar phog /de dag gi rgyud bskul/ mthu dang nus pa thams cad gtso mo'i thugs kar bsdus/ sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub 'od zer sna lnga'i tshul du byung ba bdag nyid kyi thugs kar thim par bsam pas// snying po yi ni gsang sngags 'di// rtag par bzlas pa bya ba ste// myur ba yang ni ma yin pa// thogs pa yang ni ma yin pa// mi gsal ba yang ma yin pa// gug kyed nyams pa ma yin pa// g.yeng ba'i rtog pa spangs la bzla/ zhes gsungs pa ltar bzlas la/ bsnyen pa'i man ngag zab pa'i khyad par 'ga' bla ma'i zhal las ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin bya'o// de lta bus dus rtags grangs kyi bsnyen pa bya ba ste/ rgya gzhung las/ de ltar byas pas bdun nam bcu bzhi na// lha mo gtso 'khor zhal mthong gsung yang thos// 'bring gis nyams dang tha mas rmi lam ste// lus dang grib ma ltar 'khor ci bsam 'grub// ces gsungs pa bzhin no// de'ang sngags khri phrag re re bzlas nas gtor ma 'or re btang ngo*// khu tshur gnyis bcings mdzub mo bsgreng ste kha 'gram g.yas g.yon du mche ba ltar byas la/ oṃ bhyo brta li brta li tshe/ zhes lan gsum mam bdun bzlas nas 'di skad du/ hūm̐ bhyoḥ dur khrod bdag mo dngos grub zhal// gtum mo gtsigs byed yi dwags kha// dam tshig srung ma khrag dga' mo// ki li'i sgra sgrog sbyor zin ma// dur khrod ro yi tshal dbus na// tshogs dang pho nyar bcas pa ru// gtsigs byed gtum mo dud sol ma// gsol zhig bzhes shig dam tshig lha// gnas nas gnas par mdzad du gsol// bdag gi sems la ci 'dod pa// de ni khyod kyis 'grub par mdzod// bdag gi las ni ci byed kyang*// de dag kun gyi grogs gyis shig /gsol bas dgyes nas zhal du thim par mdzod// oṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa sarba duṣṭaṃ ha na ha na bhakṣa bhakṣa phraṃ phroṃ phreṃ pheṃ phaṭ swā hā/

zhes brjod de se gol lan gsum brdabs te gtong ba dzapa ྄ma rdzogs kyi bar du rgyun du de ltar shes par bya'o// zhes grub pa'i slob dpon nā ro pas gsungs so// lnga pa bskang bshags gnyer gtad rjes kyi bya ba ni/ rgya gzhung du/ ji srid skyo bar gyur pa dang*/ de srid kyi bar du bzlas pa la skyo bar gyur na bstod pa byas la mchod pa phul/ phyag byas te lha mo gshegs su gsol lo// zhes gsungs pa ltar rje btsun gong ma mar pa yab sras kyi phyag bzhes la 'di lta ste/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo yi dam rang gzhung ltar byin gyis brlabs nas bskang ba bya ba dngos grub kyi snye ma ni/ bhyoḥ dga' ba tshal gyi dur khrod nas// 'das dang ma byon da ltar gyi// bstan pa srung bar mnga' gsol ba'i// chos skyong srung ma dud sol ma// khyod kyi thugs dam gnyan po de// rig 'dzin rnal 'byor bdag gis bskang*// dam can srung ma 'dir spyon cig /rnal 'byor dgra lha 'dir byon zhig /'bod pa'i rten rdzas yin pa'i phyir// g.yab dar nag pos thugs dam bskang*// sgrub pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir// gta' gtor chen pos thugs dam bskang*// ma dang mi 'bral 'grogs pa'i phyir// rgyun gyi gtor mas thugs= dam tshig gnyan po bsre ba'i phyir// bdud rtsi sman gyis thugs= bsten pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir// dgra bgegs sha dang nal bu'i sha// māṃ sa'i bye brag dpag med kyis// bskang ngo khyod kyi thugs dam bskang*// dgyes pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir// ra nag khrag dang bya nag khrag /dgra bgegs khrag la sogs pa yi// rakta'i rgya mtshos= dgra bgegs gsur la rngams pa'i phyir// tshil chen dud pas= chu dang tshal skyes me tog dang*// tsandan a ka ru spos dang*// dri bzang sbyar ba'i yon chab kyis// bskang ngo khyod kyi= gro nas 'bras kyi bshos gtsang dang*// 'bru tshil zhun chen snang gsal dang*// phyi yi mchod pa rnam lnga yis// bskang ngo khyod kyi=

gzugs sdug sgra snyan dri zhim dang*// ro mngar reg bya 'jam pa dang*// 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga rnams kyis// bskang ngo khyod kyi= mi rta glang sogs sha lnga dang*// byang sems rakta rgyungs pa dang*// bdud rtsi lnga la sogs pa yi// gsang ba'i mchod pas= bza' ba'i dam tshig yin pa'i phyir// bshos gtsang mar gyis brgyan pa dang*// sha chang khur ba sgog btsong sogs// tshogs kyi mchod pas= phyi yi rten rdzas yin pa'i phyir// bong bu gwa dmar lug nag dang*// dar nag ba dan ma ral gyis// bskang ngo khyod kyi thugs= nang gi rten rdzas yin pa'i phyir// rma bya nor bu'i rgyal mtshan dang*// nal bu'i rgyal mtshan bhañdza yis// bskang ngo khyod kyi= gsang ba'i rten rdzas yin pa'i phyir// a mṛ ta dang myos byed bcud// gri snying dgra bgegs nal bu'i snying*// tsitta snying gis= sku yi rten rdzas yin pa'i phyir// lugs sku btags sku bris sku dang*// dar sku sku 'bag la sogs kyis// bskang ngo khyod kyi= gsung gi rten rdzas yin pa'i phyir// rnga dang thod rnga rnga chen dang*// 'khar rnga dung dang sil chol sogs// gdung ba'i dbyangs kyis= dam tshig gnyan po bskul ba'i phyir// dam tshig dril bus= phrin las gnyan po bskul ba'i phyir// cang te'u sgra yis= 'jig rten dbang du sdud pa'i phyir// gsang ba'i rnge'u chung= thugs dam gnad nas bskul ba'i phyir// phyag rgya sngags dang ting 'dzin dang*// snying po dzapa ྄kyi bzlas pa yis// bskang ngo khyod kyi thugs dam bskang*// bhyoḥ gzhan yang thugs dam bskang ba ni// sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'dis// 'gugs byed ma dang gsod byed ma// las mkhan rnams kyi thugs dam bskang*// phrin las rnam bzhi sgrub byed pa'i// mkha' 'gro bzhi yi= dgra bgegs ma lus sgrol byed pa'i// gdong can brgyad kyi= nyams pa'i sha khrag za byed pa'i// sgo ma bzhi yi= drag po'i las la 'gyed pa'i phyir// nag mo 'bum sde'i=

gzhan yang sprul pa'i pho nya ni// dkar mo ser mo dmar mo dang*// ljang nag la sogs 'bum sde'i tshogs// bskang ngo khyod kyi= bdud kyi dmag dpung bzlog pa'i phyir// yang sprul bye ba'i= mnyes pa'i rten rdzas ma nyams phud// tshogs dang gtor ma rgya chen 'dis// 'dod khams ma mo kun gyi gtso// 'khor bcas thugs dam skong gyur cig /de ltar ma mo 'khor bcas kyi// thugs dam bskang ba'i byin rlabs kyis// rig 'dzin rnal 'byor bdag cag la// mkha' 'gro'i nyams chag byung ba skong*// 'jig rten mkha' 'gro'i gnod pa zlog /ma mo'i yams nad byung ba zlog /gshin rje'i khram la btab pa zlog /bdud kyi zhags pa nag po chod// bandhe'i byad kha slar la sgyur// sde brgyad gnod pa thams cad zlog /gzhan gyis rbad 'dre phur kha zlog /rmi ltas mtshan ma ngan pa sgyur// lo skeg zla skeg zhag skeg sgyur// sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs// bdud dang bar du gcod pa'i tshogs// thams cad thal ba'i rdul du rlog /bdag cag rnal 'byor 'khor bcas kyi// dam tshig nyams pa skong gyur cig /mchog dang thun mong la sogs pa'i// dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol// tshe dang dbang phyug spel du gsol// dpal dang grags pa bsgrub tu gsol// 'khor dang bstan pa bsrung du gsol// legs dang sprod la nyes dang bsnol// bsam pa sgrub la re ba skongs// mthu stobs skyed la dpung gnyen mdzod// lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs// nyin dang mtshan mo bya ra mdzod// gzhan yang yid la gang 'dod pa// de ni khyod kyis sgrub par mdzod// ces brjod nas bshags pa bya ba ni/ hūm̐/ 'gro ba'i don du sku mchog 'jigs pa las// 'jig rten ma lus khyab par gsal mdzad cing*// nga rgyal dregs pa can rnams 'joms mdzad pa'i// yon tan rdzogs pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo// 'da' dka' rdo rje'i dam tshig gnyer gtad pas// srung bar dam bcas sku yi dam tshig la// sku yi spyod pa tshul bzhin ma rtogs te// khams gsum ma lus khyab la bzod par gsol// rnal 'byor gdung gsob bdag cag 'dir 'dus rnams// spyi dang khyad par dam tshig mi stong yang*// klong du gyur pa'i goms shes rtsal chung ba// ma gcig lha mo'i sku la bzod par gsol// thugs rjes nges par gzigs pa'i lha mo la// dam rdzas gtsang ma'i mchod pa ma bshams te// phongs sems dbang gis mchod pa rgyu chung ba// rdzong mo dka' zlog sku la=

ma gcig sku mdog phyag mtshan phyag rgya las// don dang mthun pa tshul bzhin ma bris te// 'phags ma'i thugs rje g.yel bar gyur pa rnams// bdud las rgyal ba'i sku la= bu yi tshul gyis rgyu yi dam tshig la// le lo gnyid dbang g.yeng brel gtam la sogs// thugs dang 'gal bar gyur pa ci mchis pa// thugs rjes tshangs par rab tu bshags su gsol//

zhes dngos grub 'byung ba'i rgyud las gsungs so// gzhan yang*/ bhyoḥ thod pa dgu brtsegs srid pa'i gzhal yas nas// dpal ldan lha mo gsan cing dgongs su gsol// rang la rig pa'i ye shes rgyun ldan yang*// 'phral byung rnam rtog shin tu dbang che bas// log rtog mtshan ma gnyis kyi dbang gyur nas// ting 'dzin yi dam rtse gcig mi gsal zhing*// dpal ldan lha mo'i bka' las 'das gyur pa// bzod par gsol lo tshangs par stsal du gsol// 'bad pa rtsal chung bzlas brjod bsnyen pa chag /man ngag gzhung dang 'gal ba bzod par gsol// 'chal la g.yeng bas gsang ba'i tshig ma thub// zab mo'i don dang 'gal ba= thal mo rnga gling dus su ma tshogs te// brda yi mchod pa chag pa= bdud yum ye nas gnag pa'i tshul ston kyang*// blo zhan don ma rtogs pa= sbyor ba ye nas lha mo'i chos spyod kyang*// sbyor ba'i mchod pa chag pa= bong bu ye nas lha mo'i chibs yin kyang*// ma brten brdeg par gyur pa= gshin rje ye nas lha mo'i khyo yin kyang*// ngan sems spang sems skyes pa= rlung nag ye nas lha mo'i sprul yin kyang*// ngan pa'i sems kyis smad pa= le lo snyoms las dbang gyur= mchod pa lo zlar 'das pa= zhag nas zhag tu chag pa= nya shi dus drug chag pa= sngon nas rang gi bag chags ma sbyangs pas// dam rdzas brtul zhugs chung ba= sngon nas ser sna'i dbang du gyur lags pas// tshogs la g.yo sgyu byas pa bzod par= sngon nas shin tu gsang dbang ma thob pas// 'dod chags chos la spyad pa= brtul zhugs lta ba zab mo ma rtogs pas// rnam smin mthong nas ma bsgral= ting 'dzin lta ba klong du ma gyur pas// phud dang lhag ma ma phyed= zhe sdang dbang la nga rgyal 'dres gyur pas// rdo rje nang dme byas pa= nga rgyal dbang la phrag dog 'dres gyur pas// slob dpon sku la brdos pa= sngon nas rang sems lta ba dpangs dmas pas// rnal 'byor nye phyogs byas pa=

lta spyod zab mo'i man ngag ma rtogs pas// blo la khu 'phrig zhugs pa= lta ba drod kyi man ngag ma rtogs pas// nyams kyi drod ma skyes pa bzod par gsol// oṃ/ ye shes lha dang lha mo mi pham bdag /dang po sgrub dang bsgrub par byas nas ni// mthun pa'i dam rdzas gzhung bzhin ma tshogs pas// dpal ldan lha mo'i thugs dang 'gal gyur pas// bka' yi chad pa'i gnas su gyur lags na// ye shes thugs rje can la bzod par gsol// thugs dang 'gal bar gyur pa mthol lo bshags// dam tshig nyams par gyur pa skong gyur cig/ de ltar bshags nas tshogs mchod phul// longs spyod pa'i lhag ma rnams kha chus bran la 'byung po la ster ro// de nas las kyi gnyer gtad pa ni/ lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa la rtse gcig pa'i mig dang yid kyis bsnyen cing lta bas thal mo sbyar la smreng gsol ba 'di skad du brjod da/ོ/ bhyoḥ mkha' 'gro nag mo dud pa'i sol ba ma/ ma ltar mnyen gshin/ rgya mtsho ltar dkyel che/ ri bo ltar lhun chags/ nyi zla ltar 'od gsal/ nor bu ltar re ba skong ba/ ci bgyi'i dbang phyug ma 'khor dang bcas pa la rnal 'byor pa bdag gis gtad gnyer du bya ba'i 'os/ dngos grub rnam pa gnyis/ bka' dang bstan pa/ chos dang dam tshig /tshe dang bsod nams/ nad med pa dang bde ba dam pa/ bskul zhing bcol ba'i las/ slob ma dang 'khor/ sbyin po dang 'bangs/ dkor dang longs spyod/ mnga' ris dang dbang phyug /sde dang srid/ mchod rten dang gtsug lag khang*/ dgon gnas dang yul 'khor du bcas pa thams cad gtad kyis/ mthun zhing dgyes pa'i rten rdzas dam tshig gi gzugs su gyur pa 'di rnams la brtan par bzhugs te/ gnas lus longs spyod mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab par gyur pa/ las bcol zhing gtad pa 'di mtha' dag gi gnyer kha gyis la/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs mtha' dag las srungs/ mthun rkyen thams cad sgrubs/ gong nas gong du spel/

snying la gces pa dang yid la brnag pa ma dor bar byang chub kyi bar du brtan par skyongs la yid bzhin du 'dod pa 'jo bar byos shig ces gtad gnyer rtse gcig tu bya'o// skabs 'ga' zhig tu drag po'i gtor ma 'phang bar 'dod na 'og nas bshad pa bzhin 'dir bya'o// rjes kyi bya ba ni/ rnam lnga la sogs pas mchod la 'dis bstod pa bya ste/ bhyoḥ lha mo nag mo mthu mo che// 'phags ma khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// 'jig rten 'di na mthu rtsal che// bdag gis gus shing bstod lags na// bkra shis mchog grub gter gnas ma// yid myur rdzu 'phrul mthu stobs can// ma mor byed cing 'jig rten skyong*// dpa' brtan rtags spyod brtson 'grus che// 'thab mo'i g.yul las shin tu rgyal// gshin rje'i sring mo yin pa'i rtags// gos su zhing chen re lde gsol// spyan rtsa dmar la sdang mig can// spyan rtsa mthong na kun kyang 'dar// dad cing phyogs rnams kun sdud cing*// drang srong bden pa'i tshig gis ni// lha mo khyod la bdag gis bstod// rma bya'i sgros ni rgyan cha byas// rtag tu 'jig rten sdud par byed// seṅge stag dang spyang ki dang*// dom dred wa spyang 'phar ba sogs// rtag tu kun gyis bskor bar byed// rdo rje dril chen dkrol bar byed// khyod la bstod de phyag 'tshal bstod// ces rgyud las gsungs so/ /de nas/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*// gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni// bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba// de kun lha mos bzod par gsol// badzra lā sya rā ga ya mi hūm̐/ zhes me tog dang bcas pas dam tshig gi lha mo dang ye shes kyi lha mo 'khor bcas rten rdzas dang sku gzugs sam rang gi snying kar bsdu ba'am/ badzra muḥ zhes se gol dang bcas pas sgrub pa po khyod kyis ji ltar bsgo ba bzhin bya'o zhes khas blangs te 'khor dang bcas pa shwa dir gyis gyes par bsam mo// mchod gtor dang bskang gtor sa gtsang mar mtshan mo yin na tal 'bar btsugs te dur khrod bdag mos gshegs par bya'o// de nas smon lam gdab pa ni/

sems can thams cad nad med cing*// sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /gang gi lam gnas grol ba yi// sangs rgyas nyid dang phrad par shog /ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral ba dang*// ma grol ba rnams dgrol ba dang*// da lta nyid du rjes stsol ba'i// lam de nyid la gnas par shog/ ces pa gdan bzhi'i rgyud las gsungs so// de nas bsngo ba bya ba ste/ bdag gi dge ba'i las rnams 'di dag gis// 'jig rten 'dir ni myur du 'tshang rgya shog /'gro la phan phyir chos kyang ston byed cing*// sems can sdug bsngal tshogs kyis gzir las sgrol// zhes pa'o// bkra shis bya ba ni/ rdo rje 'chang chen tilli nā ro dang*// mar pa chos rdor mdo sde kun dga' dang*// gzi brjid grags pa rin bzang chos kyi mtshan// don grub byang chub rin chen dpal bzang sogs// brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog /zab mo rgyud kyi srung ma ma mo ni// zhal gcig phyag bzhi phrin las rnam bzhi sgrub// rdzu 'phrul mthu ldan dgra bgegs tshar gcod pa'i// khrag 'thung dud sol lha mo'i bkra shis shog /de yi sku gsung thugs sprul pho nya ni// 'gugs byed gsod byed gsum dang mkha' 'gro bzhi// gdong can brgyad dang sgo ma bzhi la sogs// las byed mkha' 'gro rnams kyi bkra shis shog/ ces skabs dang bstun pa'i shis pa brjod pa ci rigs par bya'o// de ltar bsnyen pa byas nas/ gnyis pa sgrub pa/ gsum pa las sbyor rnams bla ma'i man ngag las shes par bya la/ 'dir las sbyor las drag po'i gtor ma 'phang bar bshad pa ni/ lcags la sogs pa'i snod du bshos bu zur gsum 'khor gsum gyis bskor ba bsad pa'i sha dang khrag dang snying gis brgyan pa nad dang mtshon char byin gyis brlabs te srung ma bskul ba ni/ bhyoḥ ma g.yel ma g.yel dam can tshogs// bos pa'i dus na snyan ma sra// g.yab pa'i dus na rgyang ma ring*// bsgrub pa'i dus na gong ma g.yel// rbad pa'i tshe na mthu ma chung*// sha khrag gzan du bor nas khyod bsgrub bo// lus srog 'ben du btsugs nas khyod bsgrub bo// dam rdzas rten du btsugs nas khyod bsgrub bo// phug pa zhwa ltar gyon nas khyod bsgrub bo// rnal 'byor bdag ni gtsang shas nya bzhin myul// dam nyams dgra ni gangs khongs seng ltar rgyu// sa steng 'di na bdag la mgon med pas// ma gcig dam can thugs rjes mi dgongs sam// 'khor gyi tshogs la bka' nan mi mdzad dam// dam nyams dgra la phrin las mi mdzad dam// lha mo mi pham yi dam srog gi lha// rnal 'byor kun gyi dgra lha mo// nag mo chen mo char sprin mdog

/dpal ldan lha mo thugs dam can// rdo rje lcam gcig las mkhan ma// srog gcod nad gtong bong bu zhon// rnal 'byor bdag gi stong grogs mdzod// dam nyams kun gyi bdud gcod ma// dam tshig can gyi tshe 'dzin ma// legs nyes kun gyi stangs gcod ma// 'khor rnams pho nyar da thongs la// bstan pa 'jig pa'i dam nyams kyi// bdun rgyud rtsad nas chod la shog /lo dang zla bar ma bzhag par// zhag dang za ma nyid du sgrol// rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la// bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod// bhyoḥ sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i spyan snga ru// khyod kyis deng nas 'khor ba ji srid bar// dkar po'i phyogs kyi nad dang sdug bsngal kun// zhi bar bya phyir tshe dang bsod nams spel// nag po'i phyogs ni 'gugs 'ching dbang du sdud// smyo 'bog bsad la sogs pa'i las 'di dag /bstan pa bsrung phyir las 'di bsgrub par bgyi// 'di las 'das na rgyal ba'i bka' bslus pas// dus gsum rgyal ba'i rdo rjes mgo 'gems shog /de skad rgyal ba'i spyan sngar khas blangs shing*// dam bcas bzhin du phrin las sgrub par mdzod// rnal 'byor bdag dang bdag gi 'khor bcas la// zhal nas bdud rtsi'i char gyi rgyun phob la// nad sogs sdug bsngal tshogs rnams zhi bar mdzod// tshe dang dbang thang longs spyod rgyas par mdzod// zang zing lo tog 'bru yi phung po dang*// rin chen rkang 'gro phyugs rnams 'phel bar mdzod// da yang khyod la phrin las bcol ba ni// bla ma la smod dkon mchog dbu 'phang smad// bdag gi dge ba'i bar chad byed pa'i dgra// dam nyams dgra bo zhes bya ba'i las ngan 'di// khyod kyi shangs nas dug gi rlung bus la// 'du ba rnam bzhi'i nad rnams khongs nas slong*// pags bzhi sa la lhung nas rdeb tu chug /don snying rnam lnga'i khong khrag skyug tu chug /las ngan 'khor bcas brang chen rdung du chug
